        claims = [(item["kind"], item["ref"]) for record in records["commands"]
                  if record["command"]["op"] != "timeline.inverse" for item in record["created"]]
        claims = [(kind, self._reservation_identity(kind, ref)) for kind, ref in claims]
        if len(set(claims)) != len(claims):
            reject("identity_collision")
        self._check_birth_destinations(claims)
        occupied = set()
        for image in writes:
            row = self.conn.execute("SELECT project_id FROM project_shots WHERE id=?", (image["shot_id"],)).fetchone()
            if row is not None:
                if row["project_id"] != project:
                    reject("destination_occupied")
                occupied.add(image["shot_id"])
        allocations = self._materializations(context, prepared, inputs)
        if not writes and not claims:
            return
        current = self.revision_closure(project, timeline, prepared["expected_head"]["revision_id"])
        owned = {s["shot_id"] for s in current["shot_revisions"]}
        fresh = {s["shot_id"] for s in writes} - owned
        for shot in fresh:
            for row in self.conn.execute("SELECT project_id FROM shot_revisions WHERE shot_id=?", (shot,)):
                if row["project_id"] != project:
                    reject("destination_occupied")
                occupied.add(shot)
        heads = {shot: self.conn.execute("SELECT revision_id FROM shot_revision_heads WHERE shot_id=? AND project_id=?",
                                        (shot, project)).fetchone() for shot in occupied}

        def unchanged(shot, revision):
            return heads[shot] is not None and heads[shot]["revision_id"] == revision

        authorized = set()
        for image in current["shot_revisions"]:
            shot = image["shot_id"]
            if shot in occupied and unchanged(shot, image["revision_id"]):
                # A film pin authorizes its own projection, not a newer catalog
                # head written since that pin was accepted.
                occupied.remove(shot)
                authorized.add(shot)
        restored_items = set()
        if occupied:
            from .timeline_commit_port import command_leaves

            requested = [p for c in command_leaves(context["request"]["commands"])
                         if c["op"] == "timeline.inverse" for p in c["args"]["publications"]]
            if requested != prepared["records"]["undo_of"]:
                reject("destination_occupied")

            def edges(value):
                return {o["occurrence_id"]: (o["shot_id"], o["shot_revision_id"])
                        for o in value["parent_revision"]["payload"]["occurrences"]}

            active, output = edges(current), edges(document)
            cursor, remaining = prepared["expected_head"], set(requested)
            while cursor and (occupied or remaining):
                # history_entry authenticates the records against the receipt/event.
                entry = self.history_entry(project, timeline, cursor["publication_id"])
                previous = entry["previous"]
                if entry["intent"] == "recorded":
                    before = self.revision_closure(project, timeline, previous["revision_id"])
                    prior = edges(before)
                    if entry["publication_id"] in remaining:
                        for o, (shot, _) in prior.items():
                            owner, source = "occurrence:" + o, before["parent_revision"]
                            if (shot in occupied and unchanged(shot, prior[o][1])
                                    and output.get(o, (None,))[0] == shot) and any(
                                    w["ref"] == "shot:" + shot or w["ref"] == owner or w["ref"].startswith(owner + "/")
                                    or (w["ref"] == "timeline" and not w["path"] and w["before"] == {
                                        "state": "present", "value": {k: source[k] for k in ("revision_id", "content_digest")}})
                                    for r in entry["records"]["commands"] for w in r["writes"]):
                                occupied.discard(shot)
                                authorized.add(shot)
                                restored_items.update(i.get("item_id", i.get("id"))
                                    for s in before["shot_revisions"] if s["shot_id"] == shot
                                    for i in s["payload"].get("items", []))
                        remaining.remove(entry["publication_id"])
                    accepted_document = self.revision_closure(project, timeline, entry["revision_id"])
                    after = edges(accepted_document)
                    historical = {**entry["receipt"]["result"], "records": entry["records"], "expected_head": previous}
                    prior_allocations = (materialization_join(historical, project, timeline,
                        lambda revision: self.revision_closure(project, timeline, revision))
                        if has_materialization(historical) else {})
                    for o, (shot, _) in after.items():
                        owner = "occurrence:" + o
                        if shot in allocations or shot in prior_allocations:
                            if not self._same_materialization_slot(shot, o, allocations.get(shot),
                                    prior_allocations.get(shot), before, accepted_document):
                                continue
                        if (shot in occupied and unchanged(shot, after[o][1])
                                and output.get(o, (None,))[0] == shot and o in prior
                                and active.get(o) == prior[o]
                                and any(any(b["ref"] == owner for b in r["bindings"])
                                        and any(read["ref"] == owner + "/shot" and read["path"] == ["shot_id"]
                                                and read["state"] == {"state": "present", "value": prior[o][0]}
                                                for read in r["reads"]) for r in entry["records"]["commands"])):
                            occupied.remove(shot)
                            authorized.add(shot)
                cursor = previous
            if occupied or remaining:
                reject("destination_occupied")
        destinations, fresh_items = {}, set()
        old_items = {s["shot_id"]: {i.get("item_id", i.get("id")) for i in s["payload"].get("items", [])}
                     for s in current["shot_revisions"]}
        for image in writes:
            shot = image["shot_id"]
            for item in image["payload"].get("items", []):
                identity = item.get("item_id", item.get("id"))
                if not identity or identity in destinations:
                    reject("identity_collision")
                destinations[identity] = shot
                if identity not in old_items.get(shot, set()):
                    fresh_items.add(identity)
        for identity, shot in destinations.items():
            row = self.conn.execute("SELECT shot_id FROM shot_items WHERE id=?", (identity,)).fetchone()
            if row is not None and (row["shot_id"] != shot or shot not in authorized):
                reject("identity_collision")
            for retained in self.conn.execute(
                    "SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM shot_revisions s, json_each(s.payload_json, '$.items') i "
                    "WHERE COALESCE(json_extract(i.value, '$.item_id'), json_extract(i.value, '$.id'))=?", (identity,)):
                if (digest(json.loads(retained["payload_json"])) != retained["content_digest"]
                        or retained["project_id"] != project or retained["shot_id"] != shot or shot not in authorized):
                    reject("identity_collision")
        if not fresh and not fresh_items and not claims:
            return
        # Missing history cannot prove that a free ID was never reserved. Exact
        # matching records are authenticated against their durable receipt/event.
        if self.conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM command_idempotency c LEFT JOIN timeline_commit_history h ON h.publication_id=c.txn_id "
                             "WHERE c.command_kind='timeline.commit' AND h.publication_id IS NULL LIMIT 1").fetchone():
            reject("identity_collision")
        reservations = set(claims) | {("shot", "shot:" + shot) for shot in fresh - authorized}
        reservations.update(("item", identity) for identity in fresh_items - restored_items)
        for kind, ref in reservations:
            rows = self.conn.execute(
                "SELECT DISTINCT h.* FROM timeline_commit_history h, "
                "json_each(h.records_json, '$.commands') r, json_each(r.value, '$.created') i "
                "WHERE json_extract(i.value, '$.kind')=? AND (json_extract(i.value, '$.ref')=? OR ?='item') "
                "AND (h.project_id=? OR ?='item') AND (h.timeline_id=? OR ? IN ('shot', 'item'))",
                (kind, ref, kind, project, kind, timeline, kind)).fetchall()
            for entry in rows:
                if kind == "item" and not any(i["kind"] == "item" and self._reservation_identity("item", i["ref"]) == ref
                        for r in json.loads(entry["records_json"])["commands"]
                        if r["command"]["op"] != "timeline.inverse" for i in r["created"]):
                    continue
                ledger = self.conn.execute("SELECT * FROM command_idempotency WHERE txn_id=?", (entry["publication_id"],)).fetchone()
                if ledger is None:
                    reject("identity_collision")
                self._verify_accepted(ledger, entry)
                reject("identity_collision")

    @staticmethod
    def _reservation_identity(kind, ref):
        if kind == "item":
            member = item_identity(ref)
            if member is None:
                reject("invalid_records", "item reservation requires a canonical item ref", status=422)
            return member[1]
        if kind == "shot" and (root_identity(ref) is None or root_identity(ref)[0] != "shot"):
            reject("invalid_records", "shot reservation requires a canonical shot ref", status=422)
        return ref

    def _check_birth_destinations(self, claims):
        # Native births reserve even if a later command removes the new root.
        # Derived allocations never supply these claims; inverses were excluded.
        for kind, ref in claims:
            if kind == "shot":
                shot = root_identity(ref)[1]
                if (self.conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM project_shots WHERE id=?", (shot,)).fetchone()
                        or self.conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM shot_revisions WHERE shot_id=?", (shot,)).fetchone()):
                    reject("destination_occupied")
            elif kind == "item":
                if (self.conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM shot_items WHERE id=?", (ref,)).fetchone()
                        or self.conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM shot_revisions s, json_each(s.payload_json, '$.items') i "
                            "WHERE COALESCE(json_extract(i.value, '$.item_id'), json_extract(i.value, '$.id'))=? LIMIT 1", (ref,)).fetchone()):
                    reject("identity_collision")

    def preview(self, context, prepared, *, authorize, inputs=None):
        context, prepared = detached(context), detached(prepared)
        with self.store._mutex:
            authorize()
            if not context["request"].get("dry_run", False):
                reject("preview_requires_dry_run", status=422)
            self._check_context(context)
            self._check_head(context, prepared["expected_head"])
            self._check_shot_destinations(context, prepared, inputs)
            candidate = self._validate(context, prepared, inputs)
            request = context["request"]
            candidate["merge_mode"] = _effective_merge_mode(request)
            if "steps" in prepared["records"]:
                candidate["steps"] = prepared["records"]["steps"]
            base = {"revision_id": request["base_revision_id"], "publication_id": request["base_publication_id"]}
            return {"data": {"status": "preview", "would_status": "accepted" if prepared["expected_head"] == base else "merged",
                            "base_revision_id": request["base_revision_id"],
                            "base_publication_id": request["base_publication_id"],
                            "evaluated_head": prepared["expected_head"], **candidate}, "receipt": None}

    def _check_context(self, context):
        request = context["request"]
        realm = self._membership(request["project_id"], request["timeline_id"])
        if realm != context["realm_id"] or request_identity(context) != context["request_hash"]:
            reject("invocation_mismatch", status=422)
        if context["invocation"]["operation"] == "commitTimeline" and request != context["invocation"]["body"]:
            reject("invocation_mismatch", status=422)
        if self.history_entry(request["project_id"], request["timeline_id"], request["base_publication_id"])["revision_id"] != request["base_revision_id"]:
            reject("history_unavailable")

    def _check_head(self, context, expected):
        from .timeline_commit import StaleHead

        request = context["request"]
        current = self.head(request["project_id"], request["timeline_id"])
        if current != expected:
            raise StaleHead(current)
        base = {"revision_id": request["base_revision_id"], "publication_id": request["base_publication_id"]}
        if any(c["op"] == "timeline.restore" for c in request["commands"]) and expected != base:
            reject("stale_head")

    def accept(self, context, prepared, *, authorize, inputs=None):
        context, prepared = detached(context), detached(prepared)
        with self.store._mutex:
            if self.conn.in_transaction:
                raise ProtocolError("commit acceptance requires the outer transaction")
            with self.store._transaction():
                authorize()
                replay = self._lookup(context)
                if replay is not None:
                    return replay
                if context["request"].get("dry_run", False):
                    reject("dry_run_accept", status=422)
                self._check_context(context)
                self._check_head(context, prepared["expected_head"])
                self._check_shot_destinations(context, prepared, inputs)
                candidate = self._validate(context, prepared, inputs)
                request, previous = context["request"], prepared["expected_head"]
                from .timeline_commit_reference_projection import (
                    ReferenceProjectionError,
                    prepare_reference_projection,
                )
                try:
                    previous_document = self.revision_closure(
                        request["project_id"], request["timeline_id"], previous["revision_id"]
                    )
                    timeline = self.conn.execute(
                        "SELECT version FROM timelines WHERE id=? AND project_id=?",
                        (request["timeline_id"], request["project_id"]),
                    ).fetchone()
                    reference_projection = prepare_reference_projection(
                        self.conn, candidate["canonical_document"], previous_document,
                        next_version=int(timeline["version"]) + 1,
                    )
                except ReferenceProjectionError as exc:
                    reject(exc.reason, exc.message, status=exc.status)
                base = {"revision_id": request["base_revision_id"], "publication_id": request["base_publication_id"]}
                modern = _is_v2_request(request, prepared["records"])
                data = {"status": ("accepted" if previous == base else ("merged" if modern else "rebased")),
                        "base_revision_id": base["revision_id"],
                        "base_publication_id": base["publication_id"], "previous_revision_id": previous["revision_id"],
                        "previous_publication_id": previous["publication_id"],
                        "accepted_revision_id": candidate["canonical_document"]["parent_revision"]["revision_id"],
                        "rebased_onto": None if previous == base else previous, **candidate,
                        "publisher": context["publisher"],
                        **{k: request[k] for k in _METADATA if k in request}}
                if modern:
                    data["merge_mode"] = _effective_merge_mode(request)
                    data.setdefault("label", "Timeline edit")
                if modern and "steps" in prepared["records"]:
                    data["steps"] = prepared["records"]["steps"]
                self._persist_closure(candidate["canonical_document"])
                result = self._publish(context, data, previous, prepared["records"], prepared["semantic_events"])
                from .timeline_commit_reference_projection import (
                    apply_reference_projection,
                )
                if reference_projection is not None:
                    apply_reference_projection(self.conn, reference_projection)
                self._project_text_bindings(candidate["canonical_document"], prepared["records"], result["receipt"]["receipt_id"])
                if inputs is not None:
                    inputs.persist(prepared, result["receipt"]["receipt_id"], data["accepted_revision_id"])
                return result

    def _project_text_bindings(self, document, records, publication_id):
        """Derive live text-binding rows and events from the accepted recorder's writes.

        Runs in the acceptance transaction after _persist_closure; only this commit's
        writes are projected, so historical reuse never repoints a live row.
        """
        project_id = document["project_id"]
        shots = {o["occurrence_id"]: o["shot_id"] for o in document["parent_revision"]["payload"]["occurrences"]}
        for record in records["commands"]:
            for write in record["writes"]:
                if "/text-binding:" not in write["ref"]:
                    continue
                match = _TEXT_BINDING_REF.fullmatch(write["ref"])
                if match is None or write["path"]:
                    reject("invalid_records", "malformed text binding write", status=422)
                occurrence, kind, slot = match.groups()
                owner = "occurrence:" + occurrence
                read = next((r for r in record["reads"] if r["ref"] == owner + "/shot" and r["path"] == ["shot_id"]), None)
                shot_id = shots.get(occurrence)
                if shot_id is None or read is None or read["state"] != {"state": "present", "value": shot_id}:
                    reject("text_binding_owner_changed", "text binding owner differs from the accepted shot")
                self._project_text_binding(project_id, shot_id, kind, slot, write["before"], write["after"], publication_id)

    def _project_text_binding(self, project_id, shot_id, kind, slot, before, after, publication_id):
        from .service import RuntimeService
        from .timeline_commit_port import verify_retained_text_object, verify_text_object
        from .cas import ContentAddressedStore

        owner = self.conn.execute("SELECT project_id FROM project_shots WHERE id=?", (shot_id,)).fetchone()
        if owner is None or owner["project_id"] != project_id:
            reject("dependency_unavailable", "text binding shot is not in this project")
        binding_id = RuntimeService._text_binding_id(project_id, shot_id, kind, slot)
        row = self.conn.execute("SELECT * FROM shot_text_bindings WHERE id=? AND project_id=?", (binding_id, project_id)).fetchone()
        latest = None
        if row is not None:
            events = RuntimeService._text_binding_events(self.conn, row)
            latest = json.loads(events[-1]["payload_json"])
        live = latest is not None and latest.get("state", "present") == "present"
        current = None
        if live:
            media = self.conn.execute("SELECT size, media_type FROM objects WHERE digest=?", (row["media_digest"],)).fetchone()
            if media is None:
                reject("dependency_unavailable", "bound text media is missing")
            current = {"kind": row["kind"], "slot": row["slot"], "media_id": "sha256:" + row["media_digest"],
                       "content_hash": "sha256:" + row["media_digest"], "byte_size": media["size"], "mime_type": media["media_type"]}
        fields = ("kind", "slot", "media_id", "content_hash", "byte_size", "mime_type")
        if (before["state"] == "present") != live or (live and any(
                before["value"].get(field) != current[field] for field in fields)):
            reject("text_binding_mismatch", "recorded text binding state differs from the live binding")
        clearing = after["state"] == "absent"
        if clearing and not live:
            reject("text_binding_mismatch", "cannot clear an absent text binding")
        value = current if clearing else after["value"]
        for descriptor in ([current] if live else []) + ([] if clearing else [value]):
            selection = {"object_id": descriptor.get("media_id"), "digest": descriptor.get("content_hash"),
                         "size": descriptor.get("byte_size"), "media_type": descriptor.get("mime_type")}
            if (descriptor.get("kind"), descriptor.get("slot")) != (kind, slot):
                reject("invalid_records", "text binding row differs from its key", status=422)
            cas = ContentAddressedStore(self.store.cas_root)
            if selection["media_type"] == "text/plain" and row is not None:
                verify_retained_text_object(self.conn, cas, row, selection)
            else:
                verify_text_object(self.conn, cas, project_id, selection)
        object_digest = value["media_id"][7:]
        timestamp = now()
        if row is None:
            self.conn.execute("INSERT INTO shot_text_bindings(id, project_id, shot_id, kind, slot, media_digest, event_stream_id, head_seq, created_at, updated_at) "
                              "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, ?, ?)",
                              (binding_id, project_id, shot_id, kind, slot, object_digest, binding_id + ":shot.text_binding", timestamp, timestamp))
            head, previous_hash = 0, ""
        elif live and not clearing and row["media_digest"] == object_digest:
            return
        else:
            head = row["head_seq"]
            previous_hash = self.conn.execute("SELECT event_hash FROM shot_text_binding_events WHERE binding_id=? AND seq=?",
                                              (binding_id, head)).fetchone()["event_hash"]
        event_id, seq = new_id(), head + 1
        event_kind = "shot.text_binding.created" if seq == 1 else "shot.text_binding.rebound"
        payload = {"binding_id": binding_id, "project_id": project_id, "shot_id": shot_id, "kind": kind, "slot": slot,
                   "media_id": value["media_id"], "content_hash": value["content_hash"], "byte_size": value["byte_size"],
                   "mime_type": value["mime_type"], "publication_id": publication_id,
                   "state": "absent" if clearing else "present"}
        event_hash = hashlib.sha256(canonical_json({"event_id": event_id, "binding_id": binding_id, "seq": seq,
                                                    "kind": event_kind, "payload": payload,
                                                    "previous_hash": previous_hash}).encode()).hexdigest()
        self.conn.execute("INSERT INTO shot_text_binding_events(event_id, binding_id, project_id, seq, kind, payload_json, previous_hash, event_hash, created_at) "
                          "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                          (event_id, binding_id, project_id, seq, event_kind, canonical_json(payload), previous_hash, event_hash, timestamp))
        self.conn.execute("UPDATE shot_text_bindings SET media_digest=?, head_seq=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?",
                          (object_digest, seq, timestamp, binding_id))

    def _persist_closure(self, document):
        project_id, timestamp = document["project_id"], now()
        for image in document["internal_timeline_revisions"]:
            self.conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO internal_timeline_revisions(id, project_id, timeline_id, payload_json, content_digest, created_at) "
                              "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", (image["revision_id"], project_id, image["timeline_id"], canonical_json(image["payload"]), image["content_digest"], timestamp))
        for image in document["shot_revisions"]:
            existing = self.conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM shot_revisions WHERE id=?", (image["revision_id"],)).fetchone()
            if existing:
                continue
            payload, shot_id = image["payload"], image["shot_id"]
            self.conn.execute("INSERT INTO project_shots(id, project_id, name, metadata_json, version, created_at, updated_at, archived_at) "
                              "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET name=excluded.name, metadata_json=excluded.metadata_json, "
                              "version=project_shots.version+1, updated_at=excluded.updated_at, archived_at=excluded.archived_at",
                              (shot_id, project_id, payload.get("name") or shot_id, canonical_json(payload.get("metadata", {})), timestamp, timestamp,
                               timestamp if payload.get("archived", False) else None))
            self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM shot_items WHERE shot_id=?", (shot_id,))
            for ordinal, item in enumerate(payload.get("items", [])):
                self.conn.execute("INSERT INTO shot_items(id, shot_id, media_id, sort_key, source_frame, metadata_json, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                                  (item.get("item_id", item.get("id")), shot_id, item["media_id"].removeprefix("sha256:"), f"{ordinal:08d}",
                                   item.get("source_frame"), canonical_json(item.get("metadata", {})), timestamp))
            self.conn.execute("INSERT INTO shot_revisions(id, project_id, shot_id, internal_timeline_revision_id, payload_json, content_digest, created_at) "
                              "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", (image["revision_id"], project_id, shot_id, image["internal_timeline_revision_id"],
                                                             canonical_json(payload), image["content_digest"], timestamp))
            self.conn.execute("INSERT INTO shot_revision_heads(shot_id, project_id, revision_id, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) "
                              "ON CONFLICT(shot_id) DO UPDATE SET revision_id=excluded.revision_id, updated_at=excluded.updated_at",
                              (shot_id, project_id, image["revision_id"], timestamp))
        parent, manifest = document["parent_revision"], document["dependency_manifest"]
        existing = self.conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM parent_composition_revisions WHERE id=?", (parent["revision_id"],)).fetchone()
        if existing is None:
            self.conn.execute("INSERT INTO parent_composition_revisions(id, project_id, timeline_id, payload_json, content_digest, commit_manifest_json, created_at) "
                              "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", (parent["revision_id"], project_id, document["timeline_id"], canonical_json(parent["payload"]),
                                                             parent["content_digest"], canonical_json(manifest), timestamp))
            for ordinal, occurrence in enumerate(parent["payload"]["occurrences"]):
                self.conn.execute("INSERT INTO composition_revision_occurrences(parent_revision_id, occurrence_id, ordinal, project_id, shot_id, shot_revision_id, "
                                  "placement_json, source_offset_json, duration_ms, speed_json, track, transform_json, gain, muted, provenance_json) "
                                  "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                                  (parent["revision_id"], occurrence["occurrence_id"], ordinal, project_id, occurrence["shot_id"], occurrence["shot_revision_id"],
                                   canonical_json(occurrence["placement"]), canonical_json(occurrence.get("source_offset", 0)), occurrence["duration_ms"],
                                   canonical_json(occurrence.get("speed", 1)), occurrence["track"], canonical_json(occurrence.get("transform", {})), occurrence.get("gain", 1),
                                   int(occurrence.get("muted", occurrence.get("mute", False))), canonical_json(occurrence.get("provenance", {}))))
            dependencies = [("shot_revision", p["revision_id"], p["content_digest"]) for p in manifest["shots"]]
            dependencies += [("internal_timeline_revision", p["revision_id"], p["content_digest"]) for p in manifest["internal_timelines"]]
            dependencies += [("media", p["media_id"], p["content_digest"]) for p in manifest["media"]]
            for ordinal, (kind, identity, content_digest) in enumerate(dependencies):
                self.conn.execute("INSERT INTO composition_revision_dependencies VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                                  (parent["revision_id"], kind, identity, content_digest, ordinal))
        else:
            self.conn.execute("UPDATE parent_composition_revisions SET commit_manifest_json=? WHERE id=? AND commit_manifest_json IS NULL",
                              (canonical_json(manifest), parent["revision_id"]))

    def _publish(self, context, data, previous, records, semantic_events):
        request = context["request"]
        project_id, timeline_id = request["project_id"], request["timeline_id"]
        revision_id = data["canonical_document"]["parent_revision"]["revision_id"]
        event_ids = []
        for event in semantic_events:
            event_ids.append(self.store._append_timeline_event(timeline_id, event["kind"],
                {"project_id": project_id, "timeline_id": timeline_id, "publisher": context["publisher"], **event}))
        event_ids.append(self.store._append_timeline_event(timeline_id, "timeline.commit.accepted",
            {"project_id": project_id, "timeline_id": timeline_id, "previous": previous, "revision_id": revision_id,
             "publisher": context["publisher"], "intent": "recorded", "records_digest": digest(records)}))
        seq = self.conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM timeline_events WHERE timeline_id=?", (timeline_id,)).fetchone()[0]
        publication_id = self.store._record_command_receipt("timeline.commit", scope(context), context["idempotency_key"], context["request_hash"],
            data, project_id=project_id, event_ids=event_ids, primary_stream_id=timeline_id, resulting_stream_seq=seq)
        ledger = self.conn.execute("SELECT * FROM command_idempotency WHERE txn_id=?", (publication_id,)).fetchone()
        metadata = _history_metadata(request, data)
        self.conn.execute("INSERT INTO timeline_commit_history VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (publication_id, project_id, timeline_id, revision_id, previous["publication_id"] if previous else None,
             previous["revision_id"], "recorded", canonical_json(records),
             canonical_json(metadata), data.get("provider_version"), data.get("compiler_version"),
             context["publisher"], ledger["first_project_seq"]))
        changed = self.conn.execute("UPDATE parent_composition_heads SET revision_id=?, publication_id=?, updated_at=? "
            "WHERE project_id=? AND timeline_id=? AND revision_id=? AND publication_id=?", (revision_id, publication_id, now(), project_id, timeline_id,
            previous["revision_id"], previous["publication_id"])).rowcount
        if changed != 1:
            raise ProtocolError("head changed inside acceptance transaction")
        self.conn.execute("UPDATE timelines SET version=version+1 WHERE id=? AND project_id=?", (timeline_id, project_id))
        return self._envelope(ledger, project_id)

    def _install_entries(self, project_id, timeline_id, plan):
        for entry in plan["entries"]:
            previous = entry["previous"]
            self.conn.execute("INSERT INTO timeline_commit_history VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (entry["publication_id"], project_id, timeline_id, entry["revision_id"],
                 previous["publication_id"] if previous else None, previous["revision_id"] if previous else None,
                 entry["intent"], None, canonical_json({k: entry[k] for k in _METADATA if k in entry}),
                 entry["provider_version"], entry["compiler_version"], entry["publisher"], entry["receipt"]["project_seq"][0]))
        changed = self.conn.execute("UPDATE parent_composition_heads SET publication_id=? WHERE project_id=? AND timeline_id=? "
                                   "AND revision_id=? AND publication_id IS NULL", (plan["head"]["publication_id"], project_id,
                                   timeline_id, plan["head"]["revision_id"])).rowcount
        if changed != 1:
            reject("stale_head")

    def install_verified_baseline(self, project_id, timeline_id, *, authorize):
        from .cas import ContentAddressedStore
        from .timeline_commit_baseline import baseline_install_plan, verify_baseline

        with self.store._mutex, self.store._transaction():
            authorize()
            self._membership(project_id, timeline_id)
            current = self.conn.execute("SELECT revision_id, publication_id FROM parent_composition_heads WHERE project_id=? AND timeline_id=?",
                                        (project_id, timeline_id)).fetchone()
            if current is not None and current["publication_id"]:
                return self.head(project_id, timeline_id)
            read_object = ContentAddressedStore(self.store.cas_root).read
            facts = verify_baseline(self.conn, project_id, timeline_id, read_object=read_object)
            plan = baseline_install_plan(self.conn, facts, read_object=read_object)
            document = facts["canonical_document"]
            self._validate_closure(document)
            for entry in plan["entries"]:
                event = self.conn.execute("SELECT payload_json FROM timeline_events WHERE id=? AND timeline_id=?",
                                          (entry["receipt"]["event_ids"][0], timeline_id)).fetchone()
                manifest = {**json.loads(event[0])["dependency_manifest"], "documents": []}
                self.conn.execute("UPDATE parent_composition_revisions SET commit_manifest_json=? WHERE id=? AND commit_manifest_json IS NULL",
                                  (canonical_json(manifest), entry["revision_id"]))
            self._install_entries(project_id, timeline_id, plan)
            return detached(plan["head"])

    def adopt_empty_shell(self, project_id, timeline_id, *, authorize):
        """Bootstrap an empty headless shell or adopt its verified publication.

        A shell without a parent must have no retained parent or publication.
        Returns the publication event installed by the existing bootstrap path.
        """
        from .cas import ContentAddressedStore
        from .timeline_commit_baseline import bootstrap_install_plan

        with self.store._mutex, self.store._transaction():
            authorize()
            self._membership(project_id, timeline_id)
            current = self.conn.execute("SELECT project_id, revision_id, publication_id FROM parent_composition_heads WHERE timeline_id=?",
                                        (timeline_id,)).fetchone()
            if current is not None and (current["project_id"] != project_id or current["publication_id"] is not None):
                reject("history_unavailable")
            if not timeline_scope_is_empty(self.conn, timeline_id, project_id=project_id):
                reject("history_unavailable")
            if current is None or current["revision_id"] is None:
                if self.conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM parent_composition_revisions WHERE timeline_id=? LIMIT 1", (timeline_id,)).fetchone():
                    reject("history_unavailable")
                # Normal create retains its empty legacy projection as well.
                empty_legacy = {"shots": [], "references": []}
                for row in self.conn.execute("SELECT * FROM internal_timeline_revisions WHERE timeline_id=?", (timeline_id,)):
                    if row["project_id"] != project_id or row["payload_json"] != canonical_json(empty_legacy) or row["content_digest"] != digest(empty_legacy):
                        reject("history_unavailable")
                if self.conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM command_idempotency WHERE command_kind='parent_composition.publish' AND aggregate_id=? LIMIT 1",
                                     (timeline_id,)).fetchone() or self.conn.execute(
                        "SELECT 1 FROM timeline_events WHERE timeline_id=? AND kind='parent.composition.published' LIMIT 1", (timeline_id,)).fetchone():
                    reject("history_unavailable")
                head = self.bootstrap(project_id, timeline_id, authorize=authorize)
                entry = self.history_entry(project_id, timeline_id, head["publication_id"])
                return entry["receipt"]["event_ids"][0]
            plan = bootstrap_install_plan(self.conn, project_id, timeline_id,
                                          read_object=ContentAddressedStore(self.store.cas_root).read)
            self._install_entries(project_id, timeline_id, plan)
            return plan["entries"][0]["receipt"]["event_ids"][0]

    def bootstrap(self, project_id, timeline_id, *, authorize):
        from .cas import ContentAddressedStore
        from .timeline_commit_baseline import bootstrap_install_plan, empty_bootstrap_document

        # May compose with main's atomic create transaction. This is the sole
        # exception to accept's outer-transaction requirement.
        with self.store._mutex, self.store._transaction():
            authorize()
            self._membership(project_id, timeline_id)
            current = self.conn.execute("SELECT revision_id, publication_id FROM parent_composition_heads WHERE project_id=? AND timeline_id=?",
                                        (project_id, timeline_id)).fetchone()
            if current is not None and current["revision_id"]:
                if current["publication_id"]:
                    return self.head(project_id, timeline_id)
                reject("history_unavailable")
            document = empty_bootstrap_document(project_id, timeline_id, "bootstrap-" + new_id())
            self._validate_closure(document)
            self._persist_closure(document)
            parent, timestamp = document["parent_revision"], now()
            manifest = {k: v for k, v in document["dependency_manifest"].items() if k != "documents"}
            self.conn.execute("INSERT INTO parent_composition_heads(timeline_id, project_id, revision_id, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) "
                              "ON CONFLICT(timeline_id) DO UPDATE SET revision_id=excluded.revision_id, updated_at=excluded.updated_at",
                              (timeline_id, project_id, parent["revision_id"], timestamp))
            event = self.store._append_timeline_event(timeline_id, "parent.composition.published",
                {"project_id": project_id, "timeline_id": timeline_id, "old_head": None, "new_head": parent["revision_id"],
                 "content_digest": parent["content_digest"], "dependency_manifest": manifest})
            result = {"project_id": project_id, "timeline_id": timeline_id, "revision_id": parent["revision_id"],
                      "parent_revision_id": parent["revision_id"], "content_digest": parent["content_digest"], "payload": parent["payload"],
                      "old_head": None, "new_head": parent["revision_id"], "dependency_manifest": manifest,
                      "content_digests": {"parent": parent["content_digest"]}, "event_id": event, "created_at": timestamp}
            event_seq = self.conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM timeline_events WHERE timeline_id=?", (timeline_id,)).fetchone()[0]
            self.store._record_command_receipt("parent_composition.publish", timeline_id, "bootstrap:" + timeline_id,
                digest({"project_id": project_id, "timeline_id": timeline_id, "bootstrap": True})[7:], result,
                project_id=project_id, event_ids=[event], primary_stream_id=timeline_id, resulting_stream_seq=event_seq, created_at=timestamp)
            plan = bootstrap_install_plan(self.conn, project_id, timeline_id,
                                          read_object=ContentAddressedStore(self.store.cas_root).read)
            self._install_entries(project_id, timeline_id, plan)
            return detached(plan["head"])

","source/astrid/core/timeline/authoring_bundle.py":""""Lossless authoring bundles and deterministic candidate compilation.

This module is the narrow bridge between an immutable parent-composition
closure and ordinary, editable Python objects.  It deliberately does not
introduce another timeline language: parent, shot, and internal-timeline
payloads remain the Runtime payloads that were read from the pinned closure.

The adapter gives every placement an independent authoring ``shot_id``.  A
legacy shared child is copied in memory, with globally-scoped shot-item IDs
remapped deterministically; opening never writes.  The compiler materializes
only changed/copied children and delegates the resulting publication to the
Runtime's existing immutable-child + parent-CAS transaction.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import hashlib
import json
import re
from collections import Counter
from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Protocol, runtime_checkable

from .parent_registry import ParentRegistryError, effective_parent_registry
from .validators.meta import validate_meta, validate_timeline_meta_locations

AUTHORING_BUNDLE_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1
_DIGEST_RE = re.compile(r"^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$")
_BARE_DIGEST_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
_MEDIA_SELECTOR_KEYS = ("asset", "asset_id", "media_id", "object_id")


class AuthoringBundleError(ValueError):
    """The pinned closure or complete candidate violates the bundle contract."""


class UnsupportedAuthoringEditError(AuthoringBundleError):
    """The candidate changed a field not admitted by the current compiler."""


@runtime_checkable
class AuthoringCandidateWriter(Protocol):
    """The existing Runtime publication port consumed by candidate commits."""

    def publish_parent_composition(
        self,
        project_id: str,
        timeline_id: str,
        publication: Mapping[str, Any],
        *,
        idempotency_key: str,
    ) -> Any: ...


def authoring_contract() -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Return the small, versioned contract used by downstream editors.

    This is descriptive capability metadata for the existing Runtime payloads,
    not a serialized operation vocabulary.  Direct edits and helpers both
    modify the same fields named here and use :func:`compile_authoring_candidate`.
    """

    return {
        "schema_version": AUTHORING_BUNDLE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        "authored": {
            "parent": "parent payload except its derived occurrences closure",
            "placements": "occurrence timing, track, transform, gain, mute, provenance, and opaque fields",
            "shots": "complete shot payload and complete internal timeline payload",
        },
        "derived": [
            "base parent head and digest",
            "source-to-authoring identity mapping",
            "shot/internal/parent revision identities and content digests",
            "occurrence shot_revision_id pins",
            "dependency manifest",
        ],
        "selected_media_authority": (
            "internal timeline clip asset/media selector resolved through that timeline's registry; "
            "when a mirrored shot item changes, its media_id must resolve to the same immutable object"
        ),
        "capabilities": {
            "parent": {
                "editable": ["config", "clips", "registry", "layout", "extension_fields"],
                "derived": ["occurrences"],
            },
            "placement": {
                "editable": [
                    "order", "start_ms", "duration_ms", "track", "transform",
                    "gain", "muted", "provenance", "extension_fields",
                ],
                "guarded": ["source_offset", "speed"],
            },
            "shot_payload": {
                "editable": [
                    "items", "media_selection", "metadata", "pools", "bindings",
                    "audio", "generation_inputs", "extension_fields",
                ],
                "invariants": ["unique_item_ids", "canonical_media_ids"],
            },
            "internal_timeline": {
                "editable": [
                    "tracks", "clips", "timing", "geometry", "effects", "audio",
                    "layout", "registry_alternatives", "extension_fields",
                ],
                "invariants": ["unique_clip_ids", "selected_asset_resolves"],
            },
        },
        "timing": {
            "intervals": "half-open [start,end)",
            "placement_domain": "container-local milliseconds",
            "source_domain": "media-source offset",
            "compiler_policy": "ordinary authored field edits are lossless; interval helpers must declare quantization, ripple scope, and parent-duration policy",
            "later_edits_require": "explicit quantization, ripple scope, and parent-duration policy",
        },
        "admission": [
            "deterministic independent-shot materialization",
            "selected immutable media replacement",
            "shot item and internal clip/track structure edits",
            "placement timing, ordering, track, supported geometry, audio, effects, layout, and opaque edits",
            "parent authored payload edits except the derived occurrences field",
            "renderer-backed frozen candidate preview through managed rendering",
        ],
        "unsupported_until_extended": [
            "new media import or transcoding (use the existing media service first)",
            "renderer-specific capability negotiation",
            "placement source-offset/playback-rate edits and scale-only transforms (use internal clip trims/geometry)",
            "implicit ripple, quantization, or cross-timeline coordinate conversion",
        ],
    }


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CandidateCompilation:
    """One deterministic Runtime publication plus its authoring identities."""

    candidate_digest: str
    publication: Mapping[str, Any]
    identity_mapping: Mapping[str, Any]
    changed_identities: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
    reused_identities: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "candidate_digest": self.candidate_digest,
            "publication": copy.deepcopy(dict(self.publication)),
            "identity_mapping": copy.deepcopy(dict(self.identity_mapping)),
            "changed_identities": copy.deepcopy(list(self.changed_identities)),
            "reused_identities": copy.deepcopy(list(self.reused_identities)),
        }


def _copy(value: Any) -> Any:
    return copy.deepcopy(value)


def _canonical_json(value: Any) -> str:
    try:
        return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise AuthoringBundleError(f"authoring value is not canonical JSON: {exc}") from exc


def _digest(value: Any) -> str:
    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(_canonical_json(value).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _identity(kind: str, *parts: Any) -> str:
    encoded = "\0".join([kind, *(_canonical_json(part) for part in parts)]).encode("utf-8")
    return f"{kind}-" + hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()


def _mapping(value: Any, path: str) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
        raise AuthoringBundleError(f"{path} must be an object")
    return value


def _validate_meta_rows(rows: Any, *, path: str) -> None:
    """Validate meta on an explicit authored row collection only."""
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        return
    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
        if isinstance(row, Mapping) and "meta" in row:
            validate_meta(row["meta"], path=f"{path}[{index}].meta")


def _validate_registry_asset_meta(registry: Any, *, path: str) -> None:
    if not isinstance(registry, Mapping):
        return
    assets = registry.get("assets")
    if not isinstance(assets, Mapping):
        return
    for asset_id, entry in assets.items():
        if isinstance(entry, Mapping) and "meta" in entry:
            validate_meta(entry["meta"], path=f"{path}.assets[{asset_id!r}].meta")


def _validate_timeline_payload_meta(
    payload: Mapping[str, Any], *, path: str, include_parent_locations: bool = False
) -> None:
    """Validate known timeline meta seams without interpreting opaque descendants."""
    validate_timeline_meta_locations(payload, path=path)
    _validate_registry_asset_meta(payload.get("registry"), path=f"{path}.registry")
    if include_parent_locations:
        _validate_meta_rows(payload.get("occurrences"), path=f"{path}.occurrences")
        config = payload.get("config")
        if isinstance(config, Mapping):
            validate_timeline_meta_locations(config, path=f"{path}.config")
            _validate_registry_asset_meta(config.get("registry"), path=f"{path}.config.registry")


def _sequence(value: Any, path: str) -> Sequence[Any]:
    if isinstance(value, (str, bytes)) or not isinstance(value, Sequence):
        raise AuthoringBundleError(f"{path} must be a list")
    return value


def _string(value: Any, path: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
        raise AuthoringBundleError(f"{path} must be a non-empty string")
    return value


def _verify_digest(payload: Any, supplied: Any, path: str) -> str:
    supplied = _string(supplied, path)
    actual = _digest(payload)
    if supplied != actual:
        raise AuthoringBundleError(
            f"{path} does not match the pinned payload: expected {actual}, found {supplied}"
        )
    return actual


def _records_by_identity(
    records: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] | Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],
    *,
    identity: str,
    path: str,
) -> dict[str, Mapping[str, Any]]:
    values = records.values() if isinstance(records, Mapping) else _sequence(records, path)
    result: dict[str, Mapping[str, Any]] = {}
    for index, raw in enumerate(values):
        row = _mapping(raw, f"{path}[{index}]")
        key = _string(row.get(identity), f"{path}[{index}].{identity}")
        if key in result:
            raise AuthoringBundleError(f"{path} contains duplicate {identity} {key!r}")
        result[key] = row
    return result


def _authoring_shot_id(
    project_id: str,
    timeline_id: str,
    occurrence_id: str,
    source_shot_id: str,
    *,
    shared: bool,
) -> str:
    if not shared:
        return source_shot_id
    return _identity("shot-placement", project_id, timeline_id, occurrence_id, source_shot_id)


def _rederive_root_identity(
    placement: dict[str, Any], project_id: str, timeline_id: str, shot_revision_id: str
) -> None:
    """Re-derive a new occurrence's two derived root fields for its compiled destination.

    Only fields the row already carries are rewritten. The parent document is the
    row's own ``parent_document_id``, else the timeline id (migration's default).
    """
    from .shot_composition import stable_occurrence_deep_link, stable_output_identity

    document_id = placement.get("parent_document_id") or timeline_id
    if "stable_deep_link" in placement:
        placement["stable_deep_link"] = stable_occurrence_deep_link(
            project_id,
            document_id,
            placement["shot_id"],
            shot_revision_id,
            placement["occurrence_id"],
        )
    if "output_identity" in placement:
        placement["output_identity"] = stable_output_identity(
            project_id, document_id, placement["occurrence_id"]
        )


def _remap_known_item_references(
    payload: Mapping[str, Any], item_ids: Mapping[str, str]
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Remap the shot item codec and its declared source dependency links."""

    result = _copy(dict(payload))
    for item in result.get("items", []):
        identity = item.get("item_id", item.get("id"))
        for field in ("item_id", "id"):
            if field in item and item[field] == identity:
                item[field] = item_ids.get(identity, identity)
        # Shot dependency descriptors use metadata, or the item itself when
        # metadata is absent. Other fields and namespaces carry no reference
        # authority merely because their keys end in _item_id.
        descriptor = item.get("metadata")
        if not isinstance(descriptor, Mapping):
            descriptor = item
        for field in ("source_item_id", "source_item"):
            source = descriptor.get(field)
            if isinstance(source, str):
                descriptor[field] = item_ids.get(source, source)
    return result


def _copy_shot_for_placement(
    payload: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    project_id: str,
    timeline_id: str,
    occurrence_id: str,
    authoring_shot_id: str,
    source_shot_id: str,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, str]]:
    result = _copy(dict(payload))
    if authoring_shot_id == source_shot_id:
        return result, {}
    items = result.get("items", [])
    if not isinstance(items, list):
        raise AuthoringBundleError("shot revision payload.items must be a list")
    remap: dict[str, str] = {}
    for index, raw_item in enumerate(items):
        item = _mapping(raw_item, f"shot payload.items[{index}]")
        source_item_id = item.get("item_id", item.get("id"))
        source_item_id = _string(source_item_id, f"shot payload.items[{index}].item_id")
        if source_item_id in remap:
            raise AuthoringBundleError(
                f"shot payload contains duplicate item identity {source_item_id!r}"
            )
        remap[source_item_id] = _identity(
            "shot-item-placement",
            project_id,
            timeline_id,
            occurrence_id,
            authoring_shot_id,
            source_item_id,
        )
    result = _remap_known_item_references(result, remap)
    return result, remap


def open_authoring_bundle(
    parent_revision: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    shot_revisions: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] | Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],
    internal_timeline_revisions: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] | Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Open one exact immutable closure as a detached, lossless working copy.

    ``parent_revision`` and both child collections are the exact-head Runtime
    read results.  No mutable child head is consulted and this function has no
    persistence port, so opening cannot mutate storage.
    """

    parent = _mapping(parent_revision, "parent_revision")
    project_id = _string(parent.get("project_id"), "parent_revision.project_id")
    timeline_id = _string(parent.get("timeline_id"), "parent_revision.timeline_id")
    revision_id = _string(parent.get("revision_id"), "parent_revision.revision_id")
    payload = _mapping(parent.get("payload"), "parent_revision.payload")
    _validate_timeline_payload_meta(
        payload, path="parent_revision.payload", include_parent_locations=True
    )
    parent_digest = _verify_digest(
        payload, parent.get("content_digest"), "parent_revision.content_digest"
    )
    occurrences = _sequence(payload.get("occurrences"), "parent_revision.payload.occurrences")
    shot_index = _records_by_identity(shot_revisions, identity="revision_id", path="shot_revisions")
    internal_index = _records_by_identity(
        internal_timeline_revisions,
        identity="revision_id",
        path="internal_timeline_revisions",
    )

    source_counts = Counter(
        _string(
            _mapping(row, f"occurrences[{index}]").get("shot_id"), f"occurrences[{index}].shot_id"
        )
        for index, row in enumerate(occurrences)
    )
    candidate_parent = _copy(dict(payload))
    candidate_parent.pop("occurrences", None)
    placements: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    base_placements: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    shots: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    shot_sources: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    seen_occurrences: set[str] = set()
    seen_authoring_shots: set[str] = set()
    seen_items: set[str] = set()

    for ordinal, raw_occurrence in enumerate(occurrences):
        occurrence = _copy(dict(_mapping(raw_occurrence, f"occurrences[{ordinal}]")))
        occurrence_id = _string(
            occurrence.get("occurrence_id"), f"occurrences[{ordinal}].occurrence_id"
        )
        if occurrence_id in seen_occurrences:
            raise AuthoringBundleError(f"duplicate occurrence identity {occurrence_id!r}")
        seen_occurrences.add(occurrence_id)
        source_shot_id = _string(occurrence.get("shot_id"), f"occurrences[{ordinal}].shot_id")
        source_revision_id = _string(
            occurrence.get("shot_revision_id"), f"occurrences[{ordinal}].shot_revision_id"
        )
        shot = shot_index.get(source_revision_id)
        if (
            shot is None
            or shot.get("shot_id") != source_shot_id
            or shot.get("project_id") != project_id
        ):
            raise AuthoringBundleError(
                f"occurrence {occurrence_id!r} does not resolve to its pinned shot revision"
            )
        shot_payload = _mapping(
            shot.get("payload"), f"shot_revisions[{source_revision_id}].payload"
        )
        if "meta" in shot:
            validate_meta(shot["meta"], path=f"shot_revisions[{source_revision_id}].meta")
        if "meta" in shot_payload:
            validate_meta(
                shot_payload["meta"],
                path=f"shot_revisions[{source_revision_id}].payload.meta",
            )
        shot_digest = _verify_digest(
            shot_payload,
            shot.get("content_digest"),
            f"shot_revisions[{source_revision_id}].content_digest",
        )
        internal_revision_id = _string(
            shot.get(
                "internal_timeline_revision_id", shot_payload.get("internal_timeline_revision_id")
            ),
            f"shot_revisions[{source_revision_id}].internal_timeline_revision_id",
        )
        internal = internal_index.get(internal_revision_id)
        if internal is None or internal.get("project_id") != project_id:
            raise AuthoringBundleError(
                f"shot revision {source_revision_id!r} is missing its pinned internal timeline"
            )
        internal_payload = _mapping(
            internal.get("payload"), f"internal_timeline_revisions[{internal_revision_id}].payload"
        )
        _validate_timeline_payload_meta(
            internal_payload,
            path=f"internal_timeline_revisions[{internal_revision_id}].payload",
        )
        internal_digest = _verify_digest(
            internal_payload,
            internal.get("content_digest"),
            f"internal_timeline_revisions[{internal_revision_id}].content_digest",
        )
        internal_timeline_id = _string(
            internal.get("timeline_id"),
            f"internal_timeline_revisions[{internal_revision_id}].timeline_id",
        )
        authoring_shot_id = _authoring_shot_id(
            project_id,
            timeline_id,
            occurrence_id,
            source_shot_id,
            shared=source_counts[source_shot_id] > 1,
        )
        if authoring_shot_id in seen_authoring_shots:
            raise AuthoringBundleError(f"independent shot identity collision {authoring_shot_id!r}")
        seen_authoring_shots.add(authoring_shot_id)
        copied_shot, item_id_map = _copy_shot_for_placement(
            shot_payload,
            project_id=project_id,
            timeline_id=timeline_id,
            occurrence_id=occurrence_id,
            authoring_shot_id=authoring_shot_id,
            source_shot_id=source_shot_id,
        )
        for item in copied_shot.get("items", []):
            item_id = _string(item.get("item_id", item.get("id")), "shot payload item identity")
            if item_id in seen_items:
                raise AuthoringBundleError(f"authoring shot item identity collision {item_id!r}")
            seen_items.add(item_id)
        copied_internal = _copy(dict(internal_payload))
        source = {
            "shot_id": source_shot_id,
            "revision_id": source_revision_id,
            "content_digest": shot_digest,
            "internal_timeline_id": internal_timeline_id,
            "internal_timeline_revision_id": internal_revision_id,
            "internal_timeline_content_digest": internal_digest,
            "item_id_map": item_id_map,
        }
        shots[authoring_shot_id] = {
            "shot_id": authoring_shot_id,
            "base_payload": _copy(copied_shot),
            "payload": _copy(copied_shot),
            "base_internal_timeline": _copy(copied_internal),
            "internal_timeline": _copy(copied_internal),
        }
        shot_sources[authoring_shot_id] = source
        occurrence.pop("shot_revision_id", None)
        occurrence.pop("revision_id", None)
        occurrence["shot_id"] = authoring_shot_id
        placements.append(occurrence)
        base_placements[occurrence_id] = _copy(occurrence)

    return {
        "schema_version": AUTHORING_BUNDLE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        "project_id": project_id,
        "timeline_id": timeline_id,
        "base_parent": {"revision_id": revision_id, "content_digest": parent_digest},
        "base_parent_payload": _copy(candidate_parent),
        "base_placements": _copy(base_placements),
        "parent": _copy(candidate_parent),
        "placements": placements,
        "shots": shots,
        "source_mapping": {
            "placements": base_placements,
            "shots": shot_sources,
        },
    }


def _changed_media_selector(base: Mapping[str, Any], candidate: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
    return any(base.get(key) != candidate.get(key) for key in _MEDIA_SELECTOR_KEYS)


def _media_identity(value: Any, path: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not (
        _DIGEST_RE.fullmatch(value) or _BARE_DIGEST_RE.fullmatch(value)
    ):
        raise AuthoringBundleError(f"{path} must be a SHA-256 media identity")
    # Runtime accepts both historical bare object IDs and canonical wire IDs.
    # Normalize only comparison/dependency identities; authored bytes remain
    # untouched in the publication payload.
    return value if value.startswith("sha256:") else "sha256:" + value


def _clip_selected_media(clip: Mapping[str, Any], internal: Mapping[str, Any], path: str) -> str:
    selector_key = next((key for key in _MEDIA_SELECTOR_KEYS if key in clip), None)
    if selector_key is None:
        raise AuthoringBundleError(f"{path} has no explicit media selector")
    selector = clip[selector_key]
    if selector_key in {"media_id", "object_id"}:
        return _media_identity(selector, f"{path}.{selector_key}")
    registry = internal.get("registry", {})
    assets = registry.get("assets", {}) if isinstance(registry, Mapping) else {}
    entry = assets.get(selector) if isinstance(assets, Mapping) else None
    if not isinstance(entry, Mapping):
        raise AuthoringBundleError(
            f"{path}.{selector_key} references missing registry asset {selector!r}"
        )
    for key in ("media_id", "object_id", "digest", "content_digest"):
        if key in entry and isinstance(entry[key], str):
            try:
                return _media_identity(entry[key], f"{path}.{selector_key}.{key}")
            except AuthoringBundleError:
                continue
    raise AuthoringBundleError(
        f"registry asset {selector!r} has no canonical selected media identity"
    )


def _missing_registry_asset(clip: Mapping[str, Any], internal: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
    """Return whether a named selector has no authored registry target."""

    selector_key = next((key for key in _MEDIA_SELECTOR_KEYS if key in clip), None)
    if selector_key not in {"asset", "asset_id"} or not isinstance(clip.get(selector_key), str):
        return False
    registry = internal.get("registry", {})
    assets = registry.get("assets", {}) if isinstance(registry, Mapping) else {}
    return not isinstance(assets, Mapping) or clip[selector_key] not in assets


def _same_media_declaration(base: Mapping[str, Any], candidate: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
    return all(
        (key in base, base.get(key)) == (key in candidate, candidate.get(key))
        for key in _MEDIA_SELECTOR_KEYS
    )


def _clip_selected_media_for_edit(
    base_clip: Mapping[str, Any], candidate_clip: Mapping[str, Any],
    base_internal: Mapping[str, Any], candidate_internal: Mapping[str, Any], path: str,
    source_assets: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]] | None,
    preserve_legacy_missing: bool,
) -> str | None:
    """Resolve media while retaining one unchanged, legacy missing selector.

    A missing selector is retained only when both the declaration and its
    missing registry target are unchanged.  Any new, modified, or newly
    resolvable declaration remains a hard authoring error.
    """

    base_for_media = _with_source_asset_authority(base_internal, source_assets)
    candidate_for_media = _with_source_asset_authority(candidate_internal, source_assets)
    base_missing = _missing_registry_asset(base_clip, base_for_media)
    candidate_missing = _missing_registry_asset(candidate_clip, candidate_for_media)
    if base_missing and preserve_legacy_missing:
        if _same_media_declaration(base_clip, candidate_clip) and candidate_missing:
            return None
        raise AuthoringBundleError(
            f"{path} changes a legacy missing registry asset declaration"
        )
    if base_missing:
        return _clip_selected_media(candidate_clip, candidate_for_media, path)
    return _clip_selected_media(candidate_clip, candidate_for_media, path)


def _asset_authority(value: Any) -> dict[str, Mapping[str, Any]]:
    """Collect closed source asset entries without changing authored payloads."""

    result: dict[str, Mapping[str, Any]] = {}

    def walk(node: Any) -> None:
        if not isinstance(node, Mapping):
            if isinstance(node, list):
                for child in node:
                    walk(child)
            return
        registry = node.get("registry")
        if isinstance(registry, Mapping) and isinstance(registry.get("assets"), Mapping):
            for key, entry in registry["assets"].items():
                if isinstance(key, str) and isinstance(entry, Mapping):
                    result.setdefault(key, entry)
        for child in node.values():
            walk(child)

    walk(value)
    return result


def _effective_parent_assets(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Mapping[str, Any]]:
    """Resolve the one parent registry namespace used by validation/rendering."""
    try:
        registry = effective_parent_registry(payload)
    except ParentRegistryError as exc:
        raise AuthoringBundleError(f"candidate.{exc}") from exc
    selected = registry.get("assets", {})
    return {
        str(key): value
        for key, value in (selected.items() if isinstance(selected, Mapping) else ())
        if isinstance(key, str) and isinstance(value, Mapping)
    }


def _with_source_asset_authority(
    internal: Mapping[str, Any], source_assets: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]] | None
) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    """Return a validation-only registry view with source entries as fallback."""

    if not source_assets:
        return internal
    local_registry = internal.get("registry", {})
    local_assets = local_registry.get("assets", {}) if isinstance(local_registry, Mapping) else {}
    merged_assets = dict(source_assets)
    if isinstance(local_assets, Mapping):
        merged_assets.update(local_assets)
    merged_registry = dict(local_registry) if isinstance(local_registry, Mapping) else {}
    merged_registry["assets"] = merged_assets
    result = dict(internal)
    result["registry"] = merged_registry
    return result


def _assert_shot_edit_supported(
    base: Mapping[str, Any], candidate: Mapping[str, Any], *, path: str
) -> set[str]:
    """Validate a complete shot payload while retaining arbitrary extensions.

    Shot payloads are Runtime-owned JSON, so the adapter must not maintain a
    second closed schema.  We do enforce the identities which the Runtime
    uses to resolve media and references, while allowing ordinary metadata,
    item insertion/removal, and opaque fields to round-trip unchanged.
    """

    del base  # The candidate is checked as a complete authored value below.
    candidate_items = candidate.get("items", [])
    if not isinstance(candidate_items, list):
        raise AuthoringBundleError(f"{path}.items must be a list")
    seen_items: set[str] = set()
    changed: set[str] = set()
    for index, raw_candidate in enumerate(candidate_items):
        item = dict(_mapping(raw_candidate, f"{path}.items[{index}]"))
        item_id = _string(
            item.get("item_id", item.get("id")), f"{path}.items[{index}].item_id"
        )
        if item_id in seen_items:
            raise AuthoringBundleError(f"{path}.items contains duplicate item identity {item_id!r}")
        seen_items.add(item_id)
        if "media_id" in item:
            changed.add(_media_identity(item["media_id"], f"{path}.items[{index}].media_id"))
    return changed


def _assert_internal_edit_supported(
    base: Mapping[str, Any], candidate: Mapping[str, Any], *, path: str,
    source_assets: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None,
    preserve_legacy_missing: bool = False,
) -> set[str]:
    """Admit authored timeline edits while validating media selectors.

    Tracks, clips, effects, audio, layout, and extension fields are all
    authored Runtime payload.  Structural changes are therefore safe to carry
    through this lossless adapter; the checks here only reject malformed or
    dangling identity/media references before the existing Runtime boundary.
    """

    base_clips = base.get("clips", [])
    if not isinstance(base_clips, list):
        raise AuthoringBundleError(f"{path}.base.clips must be a list")
    base_by_id = {
        _string(_mapping(raw, f"{path}.base.clips[{index}]").get("id"),
                f"{path}.base.clips[{index}].id"): _mapping(raw, f"{path}.base.clips[{index}]")
        for index, raw in enumerate(base_clips)
    }
    candidate_for_media = _with_source_asset_authority(candidate, source_assets)
    candidate_clips = candidate.get("clips", [])
    if not isinstance(candidate_clips, list):
        raise AuthoringBundleError(f"{path}.clips must be a list")
    seen_clip_ids: set[str] = set()
    changed_media: set[str] = set()
    selected_asset_keys: set[str] = set()
    for index, raw_candidate in enumerate(candidate_clips):
        candidate_clip = dict(_mapping(raw_candidate, f"{path}.clips[{index}]"))
        clip_id = _string(candidate_clip.get("id"), f"{path}.clips[{index}].id")
        if clip_id in seen_clip_ids:
            raise AuthoringBundleError(f"{path}.clips contains duplicate id {clip_id!r}")
        seen_clip_ids.add(clip_id)
        selector_key = next((key for key in _MEDIA_SELECTOR_KEYS if key in candidate_clip), None)
        if selector_key is None:
            continue  # Text/effect/placeholder clips may intentionally have no media.
        base_clip = base_by_id.get(clip_id)
        changed_media_id: str | None
        if base_clip is None:
            changed_media_id = _clip_selected_media(
                candidate_clip, candidate_for_media, f"{path}.clips[{index}]"
            )
        else:
            changed_media_id = _clip_selected_media_for_edit(
                base_clip, candidate_clip, base, candidate, f"{path}.clips[{index}]", source_assets,
                preserve_legacy_missing,
            )
        if changed_media_id is not None:
            changed_media.add(changed_media_id)
            if selector_key in {"asset", "asset_id"}:
                selected_asset_keys.add(str(candidate_clip[selector_key]))

    registry = _mapping(candidate_for_media.get("registry", {}), f"{path}.registry")
    candidate_assets = _mapping(registry.get("assets", {}), f"{path}.registry.assets")
    # Unreferenced alternatives may be removed, but a candidate may not leave
    # a selected asset key dangling.  Existing immutable media remains in the
    # Runtime store and is never deleted by a working-copy edit.
    missing = selected_asset_keys - set(candidate_assets)
    if missing:
        raise AuthoringBundleError(
            f"{path}.registry.assets: selected asset(s) are missing: {sorted(missing)!r}"
        )
    return changed_media


def _shot_media_set(payload: Mapping[str, Any], path: str) -> set[str]:
    result: set[str] = set()
    items = payload.get("items", [])
    if not isinstance(items, list):
        return result
    for index, raw_item in enumerate(items):
        item = _mapping(raw_item, f"{path}.items[{index}]")
        if "media_id" in item:
            result.add(_media_identity(item["media_id"], f"{path}.items[{index}].media_id"))
    return result


def _shot_media_mutations(
    base: Mapping[str, Any], candidate: Mapping[str, Any], path: str
) -> set[str]:
    """Return media changed on an existing mirrored shot item.

    Newly added items are allowed to carry alternatives or metadata mirrors;
    changing an existing item to a new selected object must still agree with
    the internal timeline's newly selected media.
    """

    def index(payload: Mapping[str, Any], payload_path: str) -> dict[str, str]:
        items = payload.get("items", [])
        if not isinstance(items, list):
            return {}
        result: dict[str, str] = {}
        for item_index, raw_item in enumerate(items):
            item = _mapping(raw_item, f"{payload_path}.items[{item_index}]")
            item_id = _string(
                item.get("item_id", item.get("id")),
                f"{payload_path}.items[{item_index}].item_id",
            )
            if "media_id" in item:
                result[item_id] = _media_identity(
                    item["media_id"], f"{payload_path}.items[{item_index}].media_id"
                )
        return result

    before = index(base, f"{path}.base")
    after = index(candidate, path)
    return {
        media_id
        for item_id, media_id in after.items()
        if item_id in before and before[item_id] != media_id
    }


def _is_default_speed(value: Any) -> bool:
    if value in (None, 1, 1.0):
        return True
    return isinstance(value, Mapping) and value.get("numerator") == 1 and value.get("denominator") == 1


def _is_default_source_offset(value: Any) -> bool:
    return value in (None, 0, 0.0, {}) or (
        isinstance(value, Mapping)
        and value.get("start", 0) == 0
        and value.get("end", 0) == 0
    )


def _validate_placement_capabilities(
    placement: Mapping[str, Any], *, path: str, fields: set[str] | None = None
) -> None:
    """Reject placement semantics the shared projection cannot execute.

    For an existing placement, ``fields`` contains only values the author
    changed, so inherited legacy metadata is preserved verbatim. A placement
    with no pinned baseline is checked in full.
    """

    if fields is None or "source_offset" in fields:
        if not _is_default_source_offset(placement.get("source_offset")):
            raise UnsupportedAuthoringEditError(f"{path}.source_offset requires an internal clip source trim")
    if fields is None or "speed" in fields:
        if not _is_default_speed(placement.get("speed")):
            raise UnsupportedAuthoringEditError(f"{path}.speed requires an explicit clip playback-rate edit")
    transform = placement.get("transform") if fields is None or "transform" in fields else None
    if transform is None:
        return
    if not isinstance(transform, Mapping):
        return
    allowed = {"x", "y", "width", "height", "cropTop", "cropBottom", "cropLeft", "cropRight", "opacity", "scale"}
    unsupported = {
        key for key in transform
        if key not in allowed and not str(key).startswith("opaque_")
    }
    if unsupported:
        raise UnsupportedAuthoringEditError(f"{path}.transform has unsupported fields: {sorted(unsupported)!r}")
    if transform.get("scale", 1) != 1:
        raise UnsupportedAuthoringEditError(f"{path}.transform.scale requires explicit clip geometry")


def _internal_media_set(
    payload: Mapping[str, Any], path: str,
    source_assets: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None,
    *, preserve_legacy_missing: bool = False,
) -> set[str]:
    result: set[str] = set()
    clips = payload.get("clips", [])
    if not isinstance(clips, list):
        return result
    payload_for_media = _with_source_asset_authority(payload, source_assets)
    for index, raw_clip in enumerate(clips):
        clip = _mapping(raw_clip, f"{path}.clips[{index}]")
        if any(key in clip for key in _MEDIA_SELECTOR_KEYS):
            try:
                result.add(_clip_selected_media(clip, payload_for_media, f"{path}.clips[{index}]"))
            except AuthoringBundleError:
                if not (preserve_legacy_missing and _missing_registry_asset(clip, payload_for_media)):
                    raise
    return result


def _without_meta(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return {key: child for key, child in value.items() if key != "meta"}
    return value


def _timeline_media_view(value: Any, *, include_parent_locations: bool = False) -> Any:
    """Hide only authored meta seams in a discovery copy, leaving params intact."""
    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return value
    result = _without_meta(value)
    for collection in ("tracks", "clips"):
        rows = value.get(collection)
        if isinstance(rows, list):
            result[collection] = [_without_meta(row) for row in rows]
    registry = value.get("registry")
    if isinstance(registry, Mapping) and isinstance(registry.get("assets"), Mapping):
        result["registry"] = {
            **registry,
            "assets": {key: _without_meta(asset) for key, asset in registry["assets"].items()},
        }
    if include_parent_locations:
        if isinstance(value.get("config"), Mapping):
            result["config"] = _timeline_media_view(value["config"])
        if isinstance(value.get("occurrences"), list):
            result["occurrences"] = [_without_meta(row) for row in value["occurrences"]]
    return result


def _collect_media(value: Any) -> set[str]:
    result: set[str] = set()
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        for key, child in value.items():
            if (
                key in {"media_id", "object_id"}
                and isinstance(child, str)
                and (_DIGEST_RE.fullmatch(child) or _BARE_DIGEST_RE.fullmatch(child))
            ):
